title: The Right Dissenter
description: TLDR: Can evidence-backed dissent earn a bounded independent check, withdraw when wrong, and reopen on new evidence? Three synthetic scenarios compare Jev admission with majority, veto, always-check, fixed random checking, pooled evidence and an exact rule. Measure correct on-time decisions, harmful reversals, checking cost and recovery. Scripted votes and fixed grammar limit generalization; exploratory study, independent review pending.
